entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A Planeswalker and renowned defender of Zendikar who guilts himself over arriving too late and goes to find Jori En.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage Planeswalker brought to Zendikar to solve the puzzle of leylines; he fights with telekinesis and ends up trusting Gideon.

entities.name: Commander Vorik
entities.description: The wounded Zendikari commander who led the refugees from Sea Gate and agrees to Gideon's plan.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: A brown-skinned woman in plate armor with a halo-like ring, who helps lead the survivors.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: A merfolk who holds the knowledge about the puzzle of leylines and whom Gideon believes may still be in Sea Gate.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A Planeswalker Gideon and Jace failed to recruit on Regatha.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The monstrous swarm that annihilated Vorik's camp.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan whose hunger the spawn extend.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane under assault by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The great dam city that has fallen to the Eldrazi corruption.

entities.name: Vorik's camp
entities.description: A refuge camp in a ravine, destroyed by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: The hedron field
entities.description: The hedrons hanging above Tazeem where Gideon moves the survivors.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: The island ringed by the Bulwark mountains where Sea Gate stands.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: A region destroyed by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Sejiri
entities.description: A region destroyed by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: The kor
entities.description: Zendikari skilled with ropes who build the harnesses and ascents.

entities.name: Gideon's sural
entities.description: Gideon's weapon of four whip-like blades.

events.summary: Gideon and Jace arrive at Vorik's camp and find slaughter and Eldrazi corruption everywhere.
Gideon defends Jace from a pack of Eldrazi spawn and arms him with a sword.
events.quote: Gideon leaped between the Eldrazi and Jace.

events.summary: Gideon charges through hundreds of Eldrazi to reach a barricade of survivors and gets Jace over the wall.
Jace's telekinesis saves him from Eldrazi spawn.
events.quote: knocked back by what must have been a telekinetic blow.

events.summary: Gideon learns from a kor soldier that only a few dozen survive under Commander Vorik.
events.quote: The woman shook her head. "A few dozen."

events.summary: Gideon sends Jace with the soldiers to find Jori En and holds the wall alone.
events.quote: look for a merfolk named Jori En.

events.summary: Gideon kills a huge Ulamog-like Eldrazi with two heads by punching the smaller head and severing both.
events.quote: the Eldrazi fell dead to the ground.

events.summary: Gideon collapses the walls of a gap to block the Eldrazi and rejoins the survivors.
events.quote: he had created a defensive wall.

events.summary: Jace reports that Jori En never reached the camp and may be trapped in Sea Gate.
events.quote: He thinks Jori En was among them

events.summary: Gideon meets Tazri and the wounded Vorik, who says the survivors have nowhere to run.
events.quote: "Yes," Vorik said flatly. "We could have used you."

events.summary: Gideon proposes moving the survivors up onto the floating hedrons, and Vorik agrees.
Gideon, Tazri and the kor lead the wounded survivors up ropes onto the hedrons.
events.quote: They made the ascent with no complaints, no missteps, and no further injuries.

events.summary: Gideon sees Sea Gate's corruption from the hedron and resolves to go look for Jori En, leaving Jace to study the hedrons.
events.quote: And I'll find Jori En and bring her back here.

events.summary: Jace admits he trusts Gideon, and Gideon climbs down toward Sea Gate.
events.quote: "I have to do this," he told himself, gripping the rope.

relations.note: Gideon brought him to Zendikar and Jace says he trusts him.
relations.quote: "I do," Jace said, with a touch of wonder in his voice.
Commander Vorik had established a camp here

relations.note: They work together to organize the climb.
relations.quote: Together, Gideon and Tazri worked quickly
He fell into an easy rhythm of slaughter

relations.note: Gideon relies on her knowledge for the puzzle of leylines.
relations.quote: she'll give you everything she knows.
